articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Abbott’s Whoop Investment Puts Digital Health Wearables On Shareholders’ Radar. Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) has invested in Whoop's US$575m Series G funding round as a strategic participant. The deal links Abbott's medical device and diagnostics expertise with Whoop's health wearable and insights platform focused on consumer users. The investment highlights Abbott's interest in digital health wearables and consumer facing health data solutions. articles.title: Iran war disrupts US small businesses with shipping complications and higher costs
articles.mainIdea: Iran war disrupts US small businesses with shipping complications and higher costs
articles.summary: Associated Press: Iran war disrupts US small businesses with shipping complications and higher costs. The Iran war is making life more difficult for small business owners across the country, who are grappling with shipping complications, higher costs and consumers tightening their grip on their wallets. A shoe designer is struggling to import its shoes from Vietnam; a pistachio grower has millions of dollars worth of pistachio exports sitting in the water; a home landscaper in Kansas City is stockpiling fertilizer as prices skyrocket; and a Chicago electronics store owner is facing pain at the pump. Small business owners say the severe supply chain disruptions during the pandemic were worse — but they fear that if the war stretches on for months, it might start to come close.
